title: Concept: Pre-approved limit served in a response
description: A pre-approved limit or amount in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The figure is a decision the bank has not yet communicated, and it is commercially sensitive: it reveals the credit appetite and gives an attacker a target for loan fraud.
